_comment: Under-ceiling complete_checkout. Prior session state (running_total=4000) is pre-populated at input.context.session.policies.<writer_id> per the session-state contract — this is the running total committed by earlier checkouts in the same session. 4000 + 3000 = 7000 <= budget 10000, so allow=true and the policy emits a session write advancing running_total to 7000. input.context.mandate.session_budget is DTwo-supplied policy input, NOT a UCP field.
